assertions.description: The exact surface this change modifies exists: the popover content attribute, showPopover/hidePopover, and :popover-open matching on an open auto popover.
assertions.test: (()=>{ const p = document.createElement('div'); p.setAttribute('popover', ''); if (typeof p.showPopover !== 'function') return false; document.body.append(p); try { p.showPopover(); const open = p.matches(':popover-open'); p.hidePopover(); return open; } catch (e) { return false; } finally { p.remove(); } })()

assertions.description: dialog.closedBy reflects the closedby attribute with limited keywords: 'any' reads back 'any', and an invalid keyword falls back to the auto state ('none' for a non-modal dialog).
assertions.test: (()=>{ const d = document.createElement('dialog'); if (!('closedBy' in d)) return false; d.setAttribute('closedby', 'any'); const a = d.closedBy; d.setAttribute('closedby', 'bogus-keyword'); const b = d.closedBy; return a === 'any' && b === 'none'; })()

assertions.description: Popovers report closure through the toggle event with oldState/newState — the observable channel the light-dismiss demos correlate against input phases.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const p = document.createElement('div'); p.setAttribute('popover', ''); document.body.append(p); try { const got = new Promise((res) => p.addEventListener('toggle', (e) => { if (e.newState === 'closed') res(e.oldState === 'open'); })); p.showPopover(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); p.hidePopover(); return await Promise.race([got, new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(false), 500))]); } catch (e) { return false; } finally { p.remove(); } })()

assertions.description: Light dismiss requires trusted user input in BOTH models: synthetic pointerdown/pointerup/click dispatched outside an open popover must not close it.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const p = document.createElement('div'); p.setAttribute('popover', ''); document.body.append(p); try { p.showPopover(); document.body.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true })); document.body.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { bubbles: true })); document.body.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60)); const open = p.matches(':popover-open'); if (open) p.hidePopover(); return open; } catch (e) { return false; } finally { p.remove(); } })()
